rows.en:
(Pinon-chan seemed to enjoy herself,
so I'm really glad I invited her.)

(I came to Griffith Park with
Pinon-chan after school today, but...)

...Now that I'm here, Griffith Park
is quite an interesting place.

(Pinon-chan and I came to have tea
at Silver Moon today, but...)
Uuu...... It's bitter...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; drinking black coffee.

rows.en:
You don't have to force yourself
to drink coffee...

I-I'm not forcing myself!
It's just not quite to my taste, that's all!

(I think that's exactly what
'forcing yourself' means, Pinon-chan...)

Pinon-chan,
I'll put some sugar and milk in it for you......

Stop!
As if I could do something so childish!
Everyone knows adults drink it black.
(I don't think there's any such rule...)
Uuu...... It's still bitter~~......

(You're trying way too hard
to act grown up, Pinon-chan...)

(I think that's exactly what
'forcing yourself' means, Pinon-chan...)

(You're trying way too hard
to act grown up, Pinon-chan...)
(I really only dozed off for a second...)

Hey, are you listening, \p?!
It's because you're such a slacker
that you fall asleep in my class.
rows.notes: x8, frd_pnn_108 both genders: Pinon's line, but the script repeats it once per gender under the player's (no) name plate after 'Stop spacing out!'. Written as Pinon's line; the repeat reads as her scolding continuing.

rows.en: Sorry, Pinon-chan.
It's Pinon-sensei!
rows.notes: x6: Pinon here and in scd_com_103 (answering 'Nice to meet you, Pinon-chan').

rows.en: I'm sorry, Pinon-sensei...

Very well.
Then we'll resume your special extra lesson.
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. tokubetsu hokou 'special extra lesson' as c24176.

rows.en:
(She doesn't have to keep me after school
to study like this...)
Stop spacing out!!
Yes! Sorry, Pinon-sensei!
That's all for today.
Th-thank you very much, Pinon-sensei...

(Ugh~, she really put me through the wringer...
Pinon-sensei is a total drill sergeant......)

(Ugh~, she really put me through the wringer...
Pinon-sensei is a total drill sergeant......)

(Pinon-chan invited me to come hang out
in Deep Akihabara, but...)

This is an amazing place.
It's wrapped in some kind of
strange, feverish energy...

Pinon-chan, you wanted to come to Deep Akihabara...
Is there someplace you want to go?

W-well, actually...
I want to try going to a maid cafe!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. 'maid cafe' as c08370.

rows.en:
A maid cafe?!
Huh, why?

I've always wanted to see
what kind of place it is, just once...

If you want to go, Pinon-chan,
I won't stop you, but...
Alright! Then let's go right away!
Yeah, bring me here again!

(I'm a little surprised
Pinon-chan likes maid cafes...)

(I'm a little surprised
Pinon-chan likes maid cafes...)
Alright! We're going to the maid cafe!!
(So the maid cafe was her goal after all.)

(Pinon-chan...
She really does love that maid cafe.)
(So the maid cafe was her goal after all.)

(Pinon-chan...
She really does love that maid cafe.)

(Pinon-chan and I came to have fun
at the ranch on Island 3 today, but...)
rows.notes: Player, both genders, frd_pnn_110. 'ranch' as c04955.

rows.en: Whoa~, it's huuuge~...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; looking at a hippo-cow (see c12515).

rows.en: It's so big it's actually impressive.

\p...
Do you think I could get that big too?
Huh?! I really don't think that's possible...
Hmph... I see......

(Is that really something
to be disappointed about?)

Well, never mind. Since we came all this way,
we must enjoy ourselves.

Who'd have thought that soft serve
was made from the milk of such a huge hippo-cow...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. Review: 'soft serve' unhyphenated throughout.

rows.en:
Well, since we're here, let's have some
hippo-cow soft serve before we head home.
rows.notes: Player, both genders. Review: 'soft serve' unhyphenated throughout.

rows.en:
(Hanging out with Pinon-chan
was a nice change of pace today.)
It's so big it's actually impressive.

(Is that really something
to be disappointed about?)

(Hanging out with Pinon-chan
was a nice change of pace today.)

(Pinon-chan and I came to Nyan-Nyan
for lunch, but...)
Uuu~, it's spicy......
No, it's NOT spicy!!

(She doesn't have to force herself
to eat spicy food...)

Pinon-chan, don't push yourself.
Get something that isn't spicy......

I'm not pushing myself!
I LOVE spicy food, you know.
*munch munch*

Ahh~, it's so spicy and really delicious~
It's so good I could almost cry...

Excuse meee!
One almond tofu, please.
rows.notes: Player, both genders, ordering for Pinon. 'almond tofu' as c03443.

rows.en:
You went and ordered it, so I have no choice...
I'm only eating it because I have to, got it?!
Haaah~, it's sweet and yummy...

(Well, anyway, I'm glad I got to have
a fun meal with Pinon-chan today.)

(Well, anyway, I'm glad I got to have
a fun meal with Pinon-chan today.)

uncertain: c12479 (x8): Pinon's scolding, but the script also plays it under the player's empty name plate in frd_pnn_108 (once per gender, after 'Stop spacing out!'). Written as Pinon's line.
